name: sk-k8s-devops-bootstrap
onCreateCommand: set -eu; v=2026.11.3; case "$(uname -m)" in x86_64) a=x64; s=837acae6defb8c9ad74823f6e38856633bacb04c65c1ac67d952749847543bd9 ;; aarch64) a=arm64; s=13547a80d1dc2d5f81bb183023732f4981486e894d060e30993cc4364b4af51d ;; *) echo "unsupported architecture: $(uname -m)" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; f="/tmp/mise-v$v-linux-$a.tar.gz"; curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -fsSL -o "$f" "https://github.com/jdx/mise/releases/download/v$v/mise-v$v-linux-$a.tar.gz"; echo "$s  $f" | sha256sum -c -; mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"; tar -xzf "$f" -O mise/bin/mise > "$HOME/.local/bin/mise"; chmod 0755 "$HOME/.local/bin/mise"; "$HOME/.local/bin/mise" --version
postCreateCommand: mise trust --yes && mise install && pre-commit install
